nodes.long_description:
1. weigh the copper, iron, and aluminum.
2. place the copper, iron, and aluminum on the workbench
3. pick up the tablet with the specific heat table and controller
Record the weight and temperature of the samples on the specific heat table
4. lower the vacuum tube from the ceiling and attach it to the samples.
5. Place the samples in the steamer.
6. Start the steamer.
7. when the water in the steamer reaches 100°C, remove the sample from the steamer and measure its temperature
8. Activate the calorimeter

<Results
Understand the specific heat of different metals (aluminum>iron>copper)
nodes.short_description: Explore how different materials react to heat. This experiment teaches about specific heat capacity, the amount of energy needed to change the temperature of a substance.

Mix substances, observe genuine changes, and engage with lifelike molecular structures—all in an immersive 3D environment. Enhance your learning by interacting with accurate representations of laboratory equipment and substances, all while honing your scientific skills. Explore the world of chemistry in an unprecedented way, where hands-on experimentation meets cutting-edge technology for an educational adventure like no other.
